name: get_acl
description: Get the details of an existing Google Cloud Managed Service for Apache Kafka ACL.

parent.description: Required. The parent cluster in which to get the ACL. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster_id}

patternType.description: Required. The pattern type for the ACL.

resourceName.description: Required. The resource name for the ACL.

resourceType.description: Required. The resource type for the ACL.
